comments.author: Ramana Abhishek
comments.text: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Ramana, founder of Youkti.  We are here to change the GTM and sales industry.  Youkti is an AI-enabled revenue action platform that remembers every account and tells your sales team what to do next. The data layer is free. Problem : Sales teams pay a fortune for data and still don't know what to do with it. Every feed metered by the credit, and a rep still opens their CRM on Monday guessing which account to work. Meanwhile deals slip quietly and nobody notices until the quarter closes. Solution : Youkti keeps a running memory of every account, conversation, and deal, then turn it into a daily list of specific moves. Which deal is at risk and why. Which dormant account just fired a signal. Which renewal needs a call before it's too late. Which stakeholder joined tomorrow's meeting and what you need ready. What makes us different : Youkti gives the data away. Our take is that data got cheap and good enough for everyone, so owning it stopped being an advantage. The hard part is knowing what to do next, and that's what Youkti excels at. Free, no card, no trial clock, no usage meter: Verified mobile numbers, direct dials not switchboards ($0.40 each app

comments.author: Adithya Challa
comments.text: I agree, @ramana_abhishek   One thing I’ve really loved about building Youkti is seeing this shift from “here’s more data” to “here’s what you should do next.” The goal isn’t to give sales teams another dashboard to check. It’s to make the data they already have actually useful in the moment. That’s what we’ve been obsessed with building. 🚀

comments.text: Interesting piece of work. Do you think this is a good replacement of something like Hubspot? Also, how can I trust the action recommendations that come out of it?

comments.text: @cc_td  We have Hubspot as a connector itself so you don't have to drastically change your pipeline. You can import all the companies, prospects into our platform in just few clicks. We use agentic based recommendations so it acts as per your company's requirements/ICP. Signup with us today if you want to see the results for yourself - https://youkti.ai/

comments.author: Raghavendra Devadiga
comments.text: Caught my attention on the leaderboard. May I ask how much can you customize the workflows when the desired sales process doesn't fit a standard playbook?

Moreover we also allow you to pick and choose sales stages so that you can view where your deal is stuck. We give the entire control to the user.
